comments.text: Am currently reading Sheldrake's book, Entangled Life. Highly recommend it [LINK] Came across it because I've always enjoyed mushroom spotting in the nearby forests, and decided to explore them in greater detail. Listened to a great talk by Paul Stamets on Jo Rogan's show [VIDEO] Decided to look for a book to read, and Sheldrake's book popped up. So much of it has been fascinating, and it's a very easy read, too. It's incredible how these organisms raise so many questions about life, from panspermia to questions about individuality. Well worth a read!

We are hiring experienced engineers to help us build out our mobile and web app products.
